title: X-Ray Workspace registry
description: One entry per tool an agent reaches through. This file owns the STRUCTURE of a registry: fields, types and enums. It cannot express the cross-document rules (every depends_on and alternatives[].ref resolving to an id in the same file, ids being unique, probe_ok compiling as a regex, probes being read-only) — scripts/validate.py owns those, and loads this file rather than restating it.

$schema.description: Optional. Point your editor at this file for completion and inline errors.

owner.description: Whose access this registry describes. The map draws it as the root node.

connected_verified.description: The date somebody last checked the connected_now flags against a live session's connector list. Bump it when you re-check; the page prints it so nobody mistakes a stale flag for a live reading.

id.description: Stable slug. depends_on and alternatives[].ref point at it, so renaming one means fixing those.

category.description: manual means a human does it in a UI and no automation path exists.

access.description: The actual route, specific enough to act on. The map shows everything before the first separator under the node name, so put the kind first.

connected_now.description: MCP servers only: was it in the connector list a live session declared on meta.connected_verified? A probe, where one exists, outranks this.

owner_agent.description: The one agent, or person, accountable. One owner, never a list.

also_used_by.description: Other agents that reach for it. Drawn as faint edges.

usage_keys.description: Prefix-matched against scanner ids: mcp__<server>__, cli:<name>, skill:<name>, agent:<type>, or a bare built-in name. Empty is valid for anything that leaves no trace in a transcript.

depends_on.description: Ids this tool needs in order to work. A broken dependency downgrades this tool to degraded. Hard needs only.

alternatives.description: An empty list is a finding (single point of failure), not an unfilled field.

fix.description: What a person does next. Name the command, the host, the file. 'Re-authenticate' is not a fix.

probe.description: A read-only shell command, under 20s, never printing a secret value. null when nothing is checkable from this machine.

probe_ok.description: Optional regex matched against the probe's combined output. Omit to fall back to the exit code.

state.description: always is for a path that cannot break, such as a human using a web UI.

ref.description: Optional id of another entry, when the fallback is itself in this registry. It draws the fallback edge on the map.
